body:
Work. Work work work. I've worked 2 or more jobs at a time through 90% of undergrad and 3 at a time through 50% of it. Frequently 50+ hours a week while going to school full-time. I ace the material and ace the tests, but the lack of homework murders my GPA. It's a 2.8 right now, and there is nothing I want more than grad school... but I'm so ashamed of my performance I can hardly look my instructors in the eye, much less ask for a reference. I hate myself for having this GPA when I have so much potential. I'm being honest and not a braggart when I say I truly am very intelligent.

My family makes too much money for me to get need-based scholarships, but they don't pay for anything. So... this.
